help.overview: The Launch Schedule opens the KeepTrack launch list (keeptrack.space/launches) in an overlay for the year on the simulation clock: orbital launches with dates, vehicles, payloads, and launch sites. Use it to see what is launching next and then recreate upcoming launches with the New Launch tool.
help.howToUse:
1. Click the Launch Schedule icon in the drawer (Events mode). The schedule opens in an overlay; side menus close automatically.
  2. To see another year, set the simulation clock to that year before opening it.
  3. Browse the list, then close the overlay to return to the 3D view. If the page stays blank, use the open in new tab button in the overlay header.
help.tip1: The schedule is a page on keeptrack.space, so it requires an internet connection.
help.tip2: It is also available from the command palette as Open Launch Schedule.
